asset.name: DiffApproval
asset.description: The review surface for proposed changes with file navigation, semantic diff, comments, partial selection, risk indicators, approval, rejection, and revision requests.

requires.reason: Comparison, navigation, and colour-independent change marking are shared.
The decision itself uses the shared approval semantics and scope statement.
Actions and overflow use the shared group.

rationale: Partial selection is what makes this usable in practice: approving twelve of fifteen proposed changes is the normal case, and a surface that only offers accept-all forces users into all-or-nothing decisions they will get wrong.
